description: Configure a 'Kiosk Mode' survey for trade show lead capture. Create a new survey titled 'TechInnovate 2026 Lead Capture'. It must include three questions in an 'Attendee Details' group: 'Name' (Text), 'Email' (Text), and 'CaptureTime' (Equation type, populated with {date("Y-m-d H:i:s")}, and set to 'Always hide this question'). Critical Kiosk settings to configure: Disable 'Save IP address', Disable 'Set cookie to prevent repeated participation', Disable 'Participant may save and resume later', Enable 'Automatically load URL when survey is complete', and set the End URL to the survey's own public link (e.g., http://localhost/index.php/123456) so it loops immediately for the next user. Activate the survey when finished.
